issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named _construct_zero_state_prep_circuit (with a leading underscore), but the template and solution define and expect construct_zero_state_prep_circuit (no leading underscore). This name mismatch between the problem text and the provided code can confuse students about which function to implement and may cause tests or autograders to fail if they follow the template's names.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the naming consistent: update the problem statement to request construct_zero_state_prep_circuit (no leading underscore), or modify the template to provide and require _construct_zero_state_prep_circuit (and ensure the tests refer to the same name). Prefer updating the problem text to match the template/solution (construct_zero_state_prep_circuit) to avoid introducing a private-style name that conflicts with the provided code.
